query:
SELECT ur.permissions AS "permissions!"
          FROM citizen_role_binding b
          JOIN user_role ur ON ur.id = b.role_id
         WHERE b.org_id = $1 AND b.citizen_id = $2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ur.permissions AS "permissions!"
          FROM user_role ur
         WHERE ur.org_id = $1 AND ur.position = 0
